note: Hand-checked fixes for district schools; see README 'Refresh the data' step 8. moved: schools in a new building that MySchools and the Snapshot don't show yet; the build uses this address and point and drops facts about the old building (building use, accessibility, shared building). points: a better map point for a school whose address is right, or null lat/lon for no marker (a virtual school). closed: schools the DOE has closed that its zone file still lists; the build takes them out of their zones and off the map. entry: middle schools that take new students in a grade other than 6; the map card and school page say so instead of showing grade 6 seats. The build says when an entry is no longer needed.
